name: Bus

endCondition.description: Ends immediately when the last time stone is taken, or at round end if only one player has action markers left or no building spots remain.

categories.label: Victory point track (passengers)
categories.hint: 1 VP per passenger transported (Vrrooomm! action only).

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: the one with the most time stones wins
Then the player whose disk is at the bottom of the stack on the VP track (reached that score first) wins.

notes: family: running-track. Only the Vrrooomm! action scores. Needs min 0 on VP track; time stones are entered as count and subtracted. Rules read from the English edition rules (Capstone/Splotter).
